project_type: Python FastAPI backend + React TypeScript frontend (Vite)
build_system: Backend: pip + venv (.venv), Frontend: npm + Vite
test_framework: Backend: pytest 7.4.4, Frontend: vitest (not yet configured)

test_command: Backend: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest, Frontend: npm test (when configured)
verification_instructions: 1. Backend: Start FastAPI server (.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload), verify http://localhost:8000/health returns 200. 2. Frontend: Start Vite dev server (npm run dev), verify http://localhost:5173 loads. 3. Test SportScore provider: Run pytest for backend/tests/providers/test_sportscore.py. 4. Test frontend components: Manually verify in browser (unit tests when implemented).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No build artifacts checked into git. Backend is interpreted Python, frontend builds to frontend/dist/ (gitignored).
environment_constraints: CRITICAL: Worktree is c:\FootballIntelligence\.worktrees\phase21-sportscore (NOT the main workspace root). All paths must be relative to worktree. Backend venv: .venv (already exists). Frontend node_modules: node_modules (already exists). SportScore API: Free tier, no API key, ~1000 req/24h rate limit, 60s edge caching. NO real-time player/ball tracking available (formation view only).
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md rules 1-25 apply. Key: Rule 2 (read before editing), Rule 7 (verify after implementation), Rule 10 (never invent stats/data), Rule 12 (AI Analyst is explanation layer only), Rule 13 (never modify numerical values), Rule 14 (missing data = unavailable, not fabricated), Rule 23 (fix errors, don't report), Rule 25 (update docs/PROGRESS.md after completion).
key_patterns: Provider pattern: Inherit FootballDataProvider from backend/app/providers/base.py, implement required methods, use httpx.AsyncClient for HTTP, use ProviderCache (30s TTL for live), raise ProviderError on failure, return None for unavailable data. API pattern: FastAPI routers in backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/, Pydantic schemas, async def handlers. Frontend API client: backend/app/api/client.ts, fetch() with timeout, ApiError for failures. React components: TypeScript, functional components, hooks (useState, useEffect), CSS modules or global styles.
directory_structure: backend/: app/ (main, config, api/, domain/, providers/, database/, services/, utils/), tests/, .venv/, requirements.txt. frontend/: src/ (main.tsx, App.tsx, api/, pages/, components/, types/, hooks/, utils/, styles/), package.json, node_modules/, vite.config.ts. Root: PROJECT_SPEC.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PROGRESS.md, .env.example.
